key_idea: Count the circles, triangles and squares on each boat and check both clues.
steps: Clue 1: more than 1 circle. Boat A has only 1 circle, so it is out.
Clue 2: 2 more triangles than squares. Count both on every other boat.
Boat C: 2 triangles, 1 square. Boat D: 1 triangle, 1 square. Boat E: 3 triangles, 2 squares.
Boat B has 2 circles, 3 triangles and 1 square. 1 + 2 = 3, so both clues fit.

choice_feedback.A: It has only 1 circle, but Sara's boat has more than one.
choice_feedback.C: It has 2 triangles and 1 square. That is only 1 more triangle, not 2.
choice_feedback.D: It has 1 triangle and 1 square. That is the same number, not 2 more triangles.
choice_feedback.E: It has 3 triangles and 2 squares. That is only 1 more triangle, not 2.
